audit.why: Rumble 51.5% over 499 games. Early levels favour Rumble (Flamespitter DoT beats a tentacle-less Illaoi); the lane inverts once her field is established and two items are in. Existing level chart (Rumble/Rumble/Skill/Skill/Rumble/Skill/Illaoi) matches that shape and the win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 'late' text claims Rumble fires The Equalizer 'every 60 seconds'.
audit.why: The Equalizer's cooldown is 130/105/80 by Riot Data Dragon. 60s is not reachable at any rank without extreme haste, and the advice is built on the wrong number.
audit.corrected: Quote 80s at rank 3; treat R as a commit-punish, not a rotation timer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text says to harpoon Illaoi 'to cancel the cast' of Test of Spirit, and to 'walk out of tentacle range immediately' once the spirit lands.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is not listed as a channel and Electro Harpoon has no interrupt. Worse, Riot's own description states the target becomes a Vessel 'if killed, or if the target gets too far from the spirit' — so walking away is exactly what converts you into a tentacle farm. The correct play is to stay near the spirit and shield the swings.
audit.corrected: Do not run from your spirit; stay beside it, Scrap Shield the tentacle swings, and use the E slow to stop Illaoi dragging the spirit away from you.

audit.why: Harsh Lesson (W) is a 400-range targeted dash on a flat 4s cooldown and an auto-attack reset — it is her only gap-closer and the wind-up, not the ability cast, is the cue to step out of the cone.
audit.corrected: Named in the spikes/wants rewrite as her repeatable step-in.

audit.whatIsWrong: Her sustain is attributed to 'Cruel Testament'.
audit.why: No such Illaoi ability exists. Her healing comes from Prophet of an Elder God (P): tentacles heal her when they damage a champion. That is what makes Grievous Wounds timing decide extended trades.
audit.corrected: Name the passive and tie Oblivion Orb to it.

audit.why: Test of Spirit at 16/15/14/13/12s is genuinely the punishable cooldown, and the existing text already keys trades to it.

edits.before: The moment Test of Spirit lands, two-three tentacles spawn and your spirit takes the hits — the second she channels E, W-shield and walk out of tentacle range immediately.
edits.after: Test of Spirit rips your spirit out and tentacles swing at it — do not run. Riot's own rule is that leaving the spirit makes you a Vessel, so stand beside it and Scrap Shield the swings.

edits.before: Illaoi's Iceborn Gauntlet + Heartsteel stack makes every tentacle slap hurt through your shield, and her sustain from Cruel Testament outheals your poke — play for Equalizer and avoid solo trades.
edits.after: Iceborn Gauntlet and Heartsteel make every tentacle slap hurt through Scrap Shield, and Prophet of an Elder God heals her off each one — get Oblivion Orb up before you trade, then play for The Equalizer.

edits.before: Double-harpoon her the instant she channels Test of Spirit to interrupt the animation or force a bad position
edits.after: Double-harpoon her the instant Test of Spirit lands — the slow stops her dragging your spirit away into Vessel range

edits.before: Drop Equalizer across her escape path after she burns Leap of Faith so she cannot walk out of the burning wall
edits.after: Drop The Equalizer across her path once Leap of Faith is spent — at 130s rank 1 it punishes her commit, not the wave

edits.before: With E online you can harpoon her the instant she starts the Test of Spirit channel, canceling or ruining her angle before even one tentacle activates against your spirit.
edits.after: With E online, harpoon her the instant Test of Spirit lands — nothing in your kit cancels it, but the slow keeps her from walking your spirit into the tentacles waiting to swing at it.

edits.before: Flamespitter is your entire level 1 — she has no tentacles yet and her Q stomp range is short, so just walk at her, stay in the cone, and bank free chip. At level 2 pick up E immediately: the moment she raises her hand to channel Test of Spirit, harpoon her to either cancel the cast or force a bad angle, then circle away from wherever tentacles just spawned. Never stand still in this lane — Flamespitter is a cone you control, tentacle stomps are ground traps she does not. Keep moving laterally so her passive field never gets layered under your feet.
edits.after: Flamespitter is your entire level 1 — she has no tentacles yet and her Q stomp range is short, so just walk at her, stay in the cone, and bank free chip. At level 2 pick up E immediately: nothing you own cancels Test of Spirit, so harpoon her once it lands and stay glued to your own spirit — walking away from it is what turns you into a Vessel. Her only step-in is Harsh Lesson, a 4-second targeted hop that also resets her auto, so treat the wind-up as your cue to slide out of her tentacles, not the cast.

edits.before: Two items in, this lane becomes genuinely respectful. Her Iceborn Gauntlet slow stacks with each tentacle slap and her Cruel Testament passive means every trade costs you more than it costs her — stop taking solo duels inside her established tentacle field. Your value shifts entirely to Equalizer: split to draw her pressure, bait Leap of Faith, then immediately rotate to a teamfight and drop your ultimate across the choke. She has no answer to a Rumble who refuses to 1v1 and instead fires rockets across the map every 60 seconds. Never let her R go first in a teamfight — if she leaps into your team, flash or use your own R to cut her escape, not as an initiation tool.
edits.after: Two items in, this lane becomes genuinely respectful. Her Iceborn Gauntlet slow stacks with each tentacle slap and Prophet of an Elder God heals her off every swing that connects — stop taking solo duels inside her field unless Oblivion Orb is already finished. Your value shifts entirely to The Equalizer: split to draw her pressure, bait Leap of Faith, then rotate to a teamfight and drop your ultimate across the choke. She has no answer to a Rumble who refuses to 1v1 and fires rockets across the map every 80 seconds at rank 3. Never let her R lead a fight — if she leaps in, use the wall to cut her exit, never to open.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Once her spirit is out, running from it is what makes you the Vessel.

edits.before: - Illaoi Test of Spirit: matchup-defining — Her vessel pull. Sidestep it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Test of Spirit, 16s at rank 1: sidestep it; if it lands, stay beside your spirit. - Harsh Lesson every 4s is her only step-in. - The Equalizer is 130/105/80 — kill windows only, never chip.

notes: Fabricated ability name killed: 'Cruel Testament' is not an Illaoi ability — her sustain is Prophet of an Elder God (P). Also corrected two mechanical falsehoods: Electro Harpoon does not cancel Test of Spirit, and the old advice to walk away from your spirit is the exact condition Riot lists for becoming a Vessel. R cooldown was quoted as 60s; it is 130/105/80. Rumble kit-file derived flags for Scrap Shield (W) list 'knockup' and 'terrain' — both contradict Riot's description (shield + move speed only) and were not used. The Equalizer's 'terrain' flag is likewise a parsing artefact: it is a damage/slow zone, not a wall, so no edit claims it physically blocks movement.
